sections.title: Inputs And Discovery
sections.text: Required ref is an exact unique name/alias or discovered {token,kind?,name?,component?,occurrence?,path?}. Use entity.find with geometry:cylinder/circle and unique:true after inspecting matches, or selection.inspect for a chosen spherical face; pass the resulting description itself. Tokens must come from this document; normal faces have no editable name, so named examples require an alias. Allowed analytic types are Cylinder,Circle3D,Arc3D,Sphere only; diameter is 2*radius, not an envelope. units is mm(default)/cm/m/in. No tolerance, axis, mode or body-fitting input. Values are evaluated observations, not driving expressions.

sections.title: Context And Safety
sections.text: Requires an open Design document; no activation/recompute/mutation/save. Native root geometry reports assembly; native child geometry reports component local with its component reference. Explicit proxies require root-context occurrences from entity.list kind:occurrence; preserve returned full path and token, not a nested native occurrence token. A component reference alone selects a definition, not a placed instance. Analytic support and token validity require live geometry; offline tests do not establish either.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result is {value:number,units:string,dimension:'length',ref:Ref,method:'analytic Cylinder'|'analytic Circle3D'|'analytic Arc3D'|'analytic Sphere',context:{space:'assembly'|'component local',component:Ref}}. Ref has token:string|null,kind:string,name:string|null and optional component/occurrence:Ref,path:string; root ref is {kind:'component',name:'root'}. Executor adds success,operation,document,created:[] around result. After batch step bore returning unique entity.find, diameter input ref is {"$ref":"bore.result"}; after measurement step diameter, scalar is diameter.result.value and reference is diameter.result.ref. Do not reuse value alone as a dimensioned expression.

examples.label: Diameter Of Identified Cylinder
examples.requires: Find and inspect a cylindrical face, then entity.alias it cylinder_face in selected component. Alias must identify exactly one current face.
examples.output: result.value is analytic diameter in mm; result.ref retains the face reference.

sections.title: Inputs And Prerequisites
sections.text: ref required: exact unique name/alias or discovered token/kind/component/occurrence/path reference object. Discover analytic geometry with entity.find filters geometry:cylinder or circle, or select it then selection.inspect; pass description directly. Cylinder,Circle3D,Arc3D,Sphere only; no conical/arbitrary-body radius fit. units optional mm(default),cm,m,in. No mode or tolerance. Requires open Design document; no activation, recompute, save or mutation. Numeric radius is a snapshot, never a driving parameter.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result={value:number,units:string,dimension:'length',ref:Ref,method:string,context:{space:'assembly'|'component local',component:Ref}}. method is 'analytic ' plus the actual geometry type. Ref includes token:string|null,kind,name and optional component/occurrence refs and occurrence path. Native root and explicit root-context proxies report assembly; child native reports component local. Proxies must use occurrences discovered by entity.list kind:occurrence with full root paths; nested native occurrence contexts are rejected. Executor created:[]. Unique find step ring wires ref via ring.result; after radius step r use r.result.ref for further geometry and r.result.value with r.result.units for evidence, not as an expression string.

examples.label: Radius In Centimeters
examples.requires: A cylindrical face discovered with entity.find/selection.inspect and assigned alias cylinder_face, unique in selected context.
examples.output: result.value is geometry radius in cm, not diameter; method identifies analytic type.

sections.title: Exclusive Modes
sections.text: a,b required. minimum default resolves two geometry refs and forbids both direction and space; arrays are not entity refs in this mode. Refs are exact unique name/alias or {token,kind?,component?,occurrence?,path?} from entity.list/find/selection.inspect. Actual supported minimum geometries follow Fusion MeasureManager. projected and axial require direction:number[3] finite nonzero unitless (booleans invalid, normalized) and space exactly 'assembly' or 'component local'. In these modes a/b may be Point3D-bearing entity refs (sketch points use worldGeometry) or arrays of three explicit length expression strings. projected returns absolute dot(b-a,direction); axial keeps sign. No surfaces, cylinder-axis gaps or plane projection fallback. units:mm(default)/cm/m/in applies to scalar and closest points.

sections.title: Frames And Safety
sections.text: All referenced entities must share one native component frame or be explicit root-context assembly proxies (native root can mix with assembly proxies). Mixed native components and child-native/proxy mixtures fail. Projection arrays in component local use selected component and must agree with any point refs; pure arrays use explicitly supplied space. Minimum native child geometry is temporarily passed to MeasureManager as proxies only if that component has exactly one root-context occurrence; zero/multiple require explicit occurrence-qualified refs with full paths from entity.list kind:occurrence. Closest points are transformed back to original native frame; explicit proxies retain assembly coordinates. No activation/recompute/live transform/save; requires open Design document. Minimum distance is unsigned, not penetration depth or certified wall thickness.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: All modes return result={value:number,units:string,dimension:'length',mode:'minimum'|'projected'|'axial',context:{space:string,component:Ref}}. minimum adds points:number[2][3] in requested length units and reported frame; projection modes instead add normalized direction:number[3], with no points. No a/b/ref/method field is returned. Ref in context has token/kind/name and optional qualifications (root is kind/name only). Executor created:[]. A prior selection step chosen wires a via chosen.result.selections.0.entity and b via another intentionally selected item; $ref markers only work in a batch. To check the distance, nest this complete input in check.measurement.data, not its prior scalar result.

examples.label: Minimum Between Bodies
examples.requires: Discover two uniquely named geometry bodies in one component with entity.list; if native child context it must have one root occurrence, otherwise qualify both refs explicitly.
examples.output: result.points has two closest coordinates and result.value is unsigned minimum distance in mm.

examples.label: Signed Axial Separation
examples.requires: Open Design document; explicit array coordinates intentionally use root assembly space, no entities required.
examples.output: result.value=-10 mm and result.direction=[1,0,0]; no points field.

examples.label: Unsigned Projection
examples.requires: Open Design document; coordinates intentionally use execution-context component local axes.
examples.output: result.value=1 cm and result.context identifies selected component; no minimum geometry distance is computed.

verified: native-child proxy normalization and inverse closest points

sections.title: Input And Frames
sections.text: Required a,b and optional c are entity refs, not expression coordinate arrays. Two-entity mode supports compatible linear/planar inputs in Fusion measureAngle. Three-point mode requires point entities; b is apex. units defaults deg; only deg/rad accepted. Refs are exact unique names/aliases/origins (X/Y/Z axes), or token/kind/component/occurrence/path objects from entity.list/selection.inspect. No mode/direction/space field. Entities must share one native component frame or root-context assembly proxy space. Native child entities are passed as proxies through their unique root-context occurrence; zero/multiple occurrences require explicit qualifiers with full paths discovered by entity.list kind:occurrence. No implicit cross-component placement.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result={value:number,units:'deg'|'rad',dimension:'angle',context:{space:'assembly'|'component local',component:Ref},method:'Fusion measureAngle; second point is apex for three-point input'}. No input refs or points are returned. Context Ref is root kind/name or a discovered component token/kind/name reference. Rigid normalization for MeasureManager does not change angle or reported original context. Executor created:[]. This is a numeric snapshot, not a stored angular constraint. Requires open Design document and suitable live geometry; no activation, recompute or mutation. Prior selected point references may wire a/b/c from selected.result.selections.N.entity in a batch after identifying their order.

examples.label: Origin Axis Angle
examples.requires: Open Design document; axes are in selected component context; child native context needs a unique occurrence for MeasureManager.
examples.output: result.value is 90 deg for orthogonal origin axes.

examples.label: Three-Point Angle
examples.requires: Discover/create angle_start and angle_end point entities distinct from origin in the same context, with nonzero rays from origin; b is intentionally the apex.
examples.output: result.value is the Fusion three-point angle in radians; no points array.

sections.title: Input And Discovery
sections.text: Required ref identifies one BRepEdge or finite sketch curve exposing length. No path aggregation, infinite axis, body length or bounding-box fallback. Ref is exact unique name/alias or discovered {token,kind?,component?,occurrence?,path?}; discover BRep edges with entity.list kind:edge or select a sketch curve and use selection.inspect entity token. Do not set an unsupported enumerable kind for sketch curves. units:mm(default)/cm/m/in only. Open Design document required; no activation/recompute/mutation/save.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result={value:number,units:string,dimension:'length',ref:Ref,method:'length',context:{space:'assembly'|'component local',component:Ref}}. Ref preserves token:string|null,kind,name and optional component/occurrence/path (plus sketch/index for profile refs, though profiles are not valid lengths). Native child refs report local; root geometry/proxies report assembly, and proxy occurrences must belong to root.allOccurrences. Discover full instance paths using entity.list kind:occurrence. Executor created:[]. The value is arc length in requested units, a snapshot. A selected edge step pick wires ref using pick.result.selections.0.entity after deliberate selection; a length result retains that ref under result.ref.

examples.label: One Identified Edge
examples.requires: Discover/select one finite edge and persist alias straight_edge with entity.alias in selected component.
examples.output: result.value is its finite arc length in mm, not a path sum.

sections.title: Inputs And Modes
sections.text: ref required for face,profile,body,component,occurrence only. No explicit mode: face uses face.area, profile uses areaProperties(HighCalculationAccuracy), body/component/occurrence uses getPhysicalProperties(HighCalculationAccuracy). Body/component area is surface area, not a section. units defaults mm2; cm2/m2 only alternatives (input expressions elsewhere use mm^2 rather than this output-unit enum). Ref is unique name/alias or discovered token/kind/component/occurrence/path object. Profile may instead be {kind:'profile',sketch:Ref,index:zero-based integer} or loopCount:positive integer, exclusive; omitted selector requires exactly one profile. Discover profile loops with entity.list kind:profile; select deliberately, never infer stable indices.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result={value:number,units:'mm2'|'cm2'|'m2',dimension:'area',ref:Ref,method:string,context:{space:'assembly'|'component local',component:Ref}}. method is 'area' for face, 'profile area, high calculation accuracy' for profile, otherwise 'physical properties, high calculation accuracy'. Ref has token/kind/name, optional component/occurrence,path and profile sketch/index. root is kind/name only. Native component definitions are not instance refs; child natives report local, root/proxies assembly. Proxy contexts must be root occurrences discovered with full paths. Executor created:[]. No activation, recompute, mutation or save; high accuracy is not exactness certification. Numeric result is observed, not a driving area. For a prior unique profile inspection use inspect.result as ref, not inspect.result.area.

examples.label: Body Surface Area
examples.requires: Discover one uniquely named BodyA in selected component using entity.list kind:body.
examples.output: result.value is total surface area in mm2; method is physical properties, high calculation accuracy.

examples.label: Annular Profile Area
examples.requires: Section exists and exactly one current profile has two loops, verified by profile discovery; selector avoids inventing an index.
examples.output: result.value is profile area in cm2, method identifies high-accuracy profile calculation.

sections.title: Inputs And Prerequisites
sections.text: Required ref resolves body,component or occurrence. Use exact unique name, root, or discovered {token,kind?,component?,occurrence?,path?}. Discover bodies/components/occurrences with entity.list kind; full occurrence paths select placed instances, while component refs select definitions. Proxy contexts must belong to root.allOccurrences; native nested occurrence tokens are rejected. units:mm3(default)/cm3/m3; no tolerance/mode. HighCalculationAccuracy physical properties convert cm^3 internal volume. Surface bodies may return zero; no solid-only guard or manufacturing validation. Open Design document required, no activation/recompute/mutation/save.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result={value:number,units:'mm3'|'cm3'|'m3',dimension:'volume',ref:Ref,method:'physical properties, high calculation accuracy',context:{space:'assembly'|'component local',component:Ref}}. Ref includes token:string|null,kind,name and optional component/occurrence/path; root has kind/name only. Child native geometry reports local; root/proxies assembly. Executor created:[]. Value is an observed snapshot, not a parameter expression. To test acceptance nest {operation:'measure.volume',data:{ref:...}} in check.measurement; a prior result is not accepted in place of this operation specification. A selected body's description wires as bodies.result.entities.N only after deliberate selection.

examples.label: Body Volume
examples.requires: Open Design document with uniquely discovered BodyA in selected component.
examples.output: result.value is volume in mm3; ref is reusable and no bounds are returned.

sections.title: Inputs And Evidence
sections.text: Required ref is a body/component/occurrence exact unique name or discovered token/kind/component/occurrence/path object. Discover with entity.list kind:body/component/occurrence; root refers to root definition, full occurrence paths select instances. units:kg(default) or g. Uses high-accuracy physical properties and assigned Fusion density, including defaults; no density override, material suitability check, manufacturing allowance or uncertainty input. Native children report component local, root/proxies assembly. Proxy occurrence must be a root-context instance, not nested native token. Requires open Design document; no activation, recompute, mutation or save.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result={value:number,units:'kg'|'g',dimension:'mass',ref:Ref,method:'physical properties, high calculation accuracy',context:{space:string,component:Ref},limitations:string[]}. Ref has token:string|null,kind,name and optional component/occurrence/path; root has kind/name only. limitations explicitly disclaims material suitability. Internal mass is kg, converted to g when requested; numeric value is snapshot evidence, not a driving material property. Executor created:[]. Reuse result.ref for further geometry measurements, and result.value together with result.units for reporting. For acceptance, check.measurement must contain operation/data, not this returned value.

examples.label: Mass In Grams
examples.requires: BodyA discovered uniquely with entity.list; inspect/approve its assigned material separately before relying on mass.
examples.output: result.value is grams from assigned density; limitations remain present.

sections.title: Inputs And Included Geometry
sections.text: ref required: BRep body/face/edge,component or occurrence; no sketch/profile/mesh bounds. units:mm(default)/cm/m/in. Reference is exact unique name/root or discovered {token,kind?,component?,occurrence?,path?}. Discover with entity.list, or select a face/edge then selection.inspect. Body uses preciseBoundingBox; face/edge uses boundingBox. Component includes direct bodies plus recursive occurrence-body proxies in component frame. Occurrence recursively includes its and childOccurrences' body proxies. Root counts placed instances without adding unplaced component definitions. Includes hidden BRep bodies, excludes graphics/construction/sketches/meshes. Empty geometry, null box, nonfinite values or inverted extents raise.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result={min:number[3],max:number[3],size:number[3],units:string,context:{space:'assembly'|'component local',component:Ref},method:string}. size=max-min in requested units; there is no value,dimension,ref or volume field. Context component Ref has token/kind/name (root kind/name only). Native child definitions are local; explicit proxies/root geometry assembly, with proxy occurrence required in root.allOccurrences. Discover full nested instance paths with entity.list kind:occurrence. Executor created:[]. Result is orientation-dependent AABB, not analytic diameter/tight oriented envelope. It is a snapshot, not driving dimensions; no activation/recompute/mutation/save. A prior selected body's description can feed ref via body.result, but bounds.result cannot be resolved as a geometry reference.

examples.label: One Body Envelope
examples.requires: BodyA is uniquely discovered BRep geometry in selected component.
examples.output: result.min/max/size are mm vectors, not a scalar value.

examples.label: Placed Assembly Envelope
examples.requires: Open Design document with at least one direct or recursively placed BRep body.
examples.output: result.context.space is assembly; result.size is root-context union size in cm.

sections.title: Input And Context
sections.text: body and plane required refs; body must resolve BRepBody, plane geometry must be Plane (construction plane or planar face). mode only curves, default; units:mm(default)/cm/m/in for lengths only. Refs are unique names/aliases/origins or discovered token/kind/component/occurrence/path objects. Discover bodies and planes using entity.list/find; XY origin is selected-context plane. Body and plane must share one native component frame or assembly proxy/root frame. Explicit proxy occurrences must be root-context paths from entity.list kind:occurrence. Temporary copy of native body is transformed into assembly using occurrence.transform2 when proxied; no live geometry is added. No filled-area mode, UI section feature or appearance changes.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result={context:{space:string,component:Ref},method:'temporary B-Rep plane intersection',curves:Curve[],edgeCount:integer,totalLength:{value:number,units:string,dimension:'length'},limitations:string[]}. Curve has type:string,lengthUnits:'cm',angleUnits:'rad', optional origin/center/normal/axis/direction/startPoint/endPoint/xyz:number[3],radius/majorRadius/minorRadius/halfAngle/startAngle/endAngle:number, plus length:{value:number,units:string,dimension:'length'}. Curves do not have entity tokens, space fields or complete NURBS control data; outer context supplies frame. Coordinates/radii always cm and analytic angles rad even when length is in inches. Executor created:[]. Null wire raises ambiguous no-intersection/kernel failure, never verified empty; a nonnull wire with zero edges yields edgeCount:0,totalLength.value:0. No closed-loop or material continuity proof. Requires open Design document, no activation/recompute/save. Curves are snapshots and cannot serve as persistent edge refs.

examples.label: Body Intersection With XY
examples.requires: BodyA discovered in same context as XY and the actual body-plane intersection produces a nonnull wire; feasibility requires live geometry.
examples.output: result.curves[] contains analytic descriptors where available; result.totalLength uses cm and edgeCount is explicit.

verified: null wire versus empty edge collection

sections.title: Inputs And Frame
sections.text: body is an explicit solid body ref; frame is exactly {space:'assembly'|'component local',component:componentRef} and must match the body. origin is three explicit length expressions in that frame; normal is a nonzero finite unitless 3-vector normalized by the API; stations is a nonempty array of signed length expressions, each offset independently from origin along normal. Use root-context occurrence-qualified body refs for assembly placement; component-local refs cannot be mixed with assembly geometry. No inferred station range or automatic scan is performed.

sections.title: Native Loops And Coverage
sections.text: Each station is intersected using temporary BRep geometry. Native face loops label outer versus inner; closed, non-overlapping planar wires and face construction must succeed. Result has area in cm² and area-equivalent diameter in cm; this derived diameter is not a minimum wall, analytic bore or clearance. Exact circle diameter is present only for a single circular edge. Coverage states requested/complete discrete stations and continuous:false. Missing/null wire is unknown (not verified empty), and open curves, incomplete edges, loop/face errors or kernel exceptions retain explicit missing values and unknown status. A complete series never independently reports pass.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result={schemaVersion:1,operation:'measure.section-series',status:'complete'|'unknown',frame,associativity:'snapshot',affected:[],warnings:[],method,units:{length:'cm',area:'cm^2',volume:'cm^3',angle:'rad'},precision:'kernel',precisionDetail:{method:'native BRep kernel',exact:false,kernelTolerance},origin:number[3],normal:number[3],stations:[{index,offset,status:'complete'|'unknown',loops:[{role:'outer'|'inner',closed:true,area,diameter:number|null,equivalentAreaDiameter,curves}]|null,area:number|null,reason?}],coverage:'partial'|'unknown',coverageDetail:{kind:'discrete stations only',continuous:false,requested,complete},kernelCalls,limitations}. A complete series has no overall passed verdict and remains partial coverage; unknown stations have coverage:'unknown' with missing values.

sections.title: Budget And Mutation
sections.text: Optional limits: stations default 64/max 256; edges per station 4096/16384; kernelCalls 512/4096; output bytes 1048576/4194304; timeMs 30000/120000. All specified values are positive integers. The timer gates admission only; an in-flight synchronous Fusion call is indivisible. Bodies are private temporary copies; no model feature is created, repaired or moved. Coordinates/offsets cm, area cm², angles rad. precisionDetail.exact is false and the SDK-controlled kernel tolerance is not certified. This evidence describes discrete planes, not sampled-to-exact coverage of the intervening body.

examples.label: Two Independent Annular Stations
examples.requires: Discover a solid body in the stated root assembly frame. The example executes separate planes only; inspect each station's status and loop roles.
examples.output: result.coverage is partial after completed stations; coverageDetail.continuous is false and each station reports native loop coverage.

verified: offline failure policy, units/frames, explicit discrete coverage, budgets, canonical bundle ownership and typed CLI/MCP broker path
bugs: Native Fusion loop/kernel semantics and scratch restore have not been qualified; explicit user consent is required.

sections.title: Finite Inputs And Decision
sections.text: body and witness are explicit solid BRep refs in the same exact declared frame. witness must be finite with positive volume. expect:'material' computes witness−body; expect:'void' computes witness∩body. Pass requires the valid finite residual volume to be no greater than explicit nonnegative volumeTolerance. This is a finite-volume Boolean check, never a collection of containment samples; point hits cannot establish the whole witness.

sections.title: Unknown, Limits And Mutation
sections.text: A false/throwing Boolean, invalid/nonfinite result, null/invalid residual or kernel exception produces unknown and passed:false. A frame mismatch or nonsolid input is rejected before the Boolean; neither produces a pass. An invalid body after Boolean is not assumed to mean an empty set. No failed or unresolved kernel result is verified empty. Optional limits: kernelCalls default 512/max 4096, output bytes 1048576/4194304 and timeMs 30000/120000; in-flight synchronous SDK calls cannot be interrupted. Inputs are privately copied; the document is not modified. Positive-volume tolerance evidence does not prove topology, boundary/contact clearance, physical fitness or mathematical exactness. precisionDetail.exact is false and native Fusion acceptance requires separate consent.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result={schemaVersion:1,operation:'measure.witness-check',status:'pass'|'fail'|'unknown',passed:boolean|null,expect,coverage:'pass'|'unknown',coverageDetail:{kind:'finite solid Boolean',sampled:false},witnessVolume:number,residualVolume:number|null,volumeTolerance:number,frame,associativity:'snapshot',affected:[],warnings:[],method,units:{length:'cm',area:'cm^2',volume:'cm^3',angle:'rad'},precision:'kernel',precisionDetail:{method:'native BRep kernel',exact:false,kernelTolerance:string},kernelCalls,limitations}. Unknown has residualVolume:null and passed:null; a negative Boolean result has passed:false. Boolean coverage and decision status are distinct: a covered counterexample can be a fail. The finite witness and exact tolerance are reported in cm³; application output is a snapshot.

examples.label: Require A Finite Material Witness
examples.requires: Discover both solids in one assembly frame and independently choose the allowed residual volume. This is a request example, not native qualification.
examples.output: status is pass only when a successful finite Boolean leaves at most the declared residual volume; point samples are not consumed.

verified: offline Boolean policy, strict frame/solid/tolerance validation, typed CLI/MCP fake-broker dispatch and owned prepared bundle
bugs: Native Fusion Boolean empty-result conventions and scratch restore have not been qualified; explicit user consent is required.

sections.title: Inputs And Geometric Preconditions
sections.text: a,b required face refs, discovered by entity.find geometry:plane or selection.inspect and reused directly or aliased. Ref object accepts token/kind/component/occurrence/path. Faces must belong to the same body instance, be planar, parallel or antiparallel, noncoincident and overlap along their normals. mode only parallelPlanes (default). tolerance nonnegative explicit length expression default '0.001 mm'; angleTolerance explicit nonnegative angle strictly below 90 deg default '0.001 deg'; units:mm(default)/cm/m/in. Normals normalized; separation is absolute dot(originB-originA,normalA), not a bounding box. Finite-face minimum distance must agree within tolerance and plane separation must exceed tolerance. This guard does not prove intervening solid material or global minimum wall.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result={value:number,units:string,dimension:'length',context:{space:'assembly'|'component local',component:Ref},method:'selected parallel face separation',limitations:string[]}. No a/b/ref/points/overlap boolean. Executor created:[]. All input refs need compatible native-component or root assembly context. Native child faces are passed to MeasureManager as proxies only when their component has exactly one root-context occurrence; zero/multiple require explicit full-path occurrence refs from entity.list kind:occurrence. Analytic distance and reported original frame are preserved. Open Design document required; no activation/recompute/mutation/save. Global/curved/ray-sampled modes unsupported; numeric result is snapshot evidence. To check thickness nest this input under check.measurement.data and specify independent bounds, not a generic wall certification.

examples.label: Selected Parallel Walls
examples.requires: Discover and alias two distinct planar faces of one body as front_face/back_face. Verify intended wall faces; they must overlap normally and share context.
examples.output: result.value is selected parallel-plane separation in mm; limitations disclaims material continuity/global minimum.

sections.title: Input And Identity
sections.text: bodies is a nonempty unique-role array of {role,body} solid BRep refs. frame is exactly assembly/component local or {space,component}, matching the actual native/proxy context. scope must be durable. Supply --doc-id or --doc-file-id; only a saved DataFile with current fileId/version can be captured. workBudgetMs is 1..300000 (default 30000); synchronous Fusion kernel/export calls cannot be interrupted mid-call.

sections.title: Exact Serialization And Ownership
sections.text: The broker creates fresh private .cad/baseline-staging files and passes their paths only through an internal baseline operation. Python does not accept a user path or arbitrary artifact handle. The broker reads the settled exact payload bytes, writes them with the shared owned baseline manifest/checksum port, then removes only that operation's stage directory. Unknown/throwing SDK turns retain stage evidence for reconciliation and must not be replayed. If no exact TemporaryBRepManager serializer/staging binder is installed, status is unsupported; no mesh, bbox or volume-only substitute.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result={status:'pass'|'unsupported'|'stale'|'unknown',precision:'exact',baseline:{version:1,scope:'durable',owner,id,sha256},manifest:{version:1,scope:'durable',source:{document,version},frame,bodies:[{role,body,instance,pose}]},bodyPayloads:[{role,bytes}],limitations}. Capture produces an owned artifact reference; saved document bytes are not modified and no save/recompute occurs. This result alone does not qualify real SDK export/import.

examples.label: Two Role-Pinned Solids
examples.requires: Discover both solid bodies and their root-context occurrence paths. The broker project owns the artifacts; pin the target DataFile. This example is documentation only and not executed by help.
examples.output: Capture returns an opaque owner-bound baseline reference, exact per-body bytes/checksums and the manifest's source version and transforms.

verified: offline contract, canonical prepared bundle, typed CLI/MCP dispatcher, fake broker, owner-bound bytes/checksums and path refusals
bugs: Native export/import and geometry remain unqualified; explicit consent and an actual synthetic scratch roundtrip are required.

sections.title: Input And Scope
sections.text: baseline is exactly the opaque version-1 durable reference returned by capture. The project owner is derived from the broker's canonical project directory, never from request JSON. No Fusion document pin or SDK invocation is required for offline integrity inspection.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result={status:'pass'|'missing',precision:'exact',baseline,manifest,bodyPayloads:[{role,bytes}],limitations}. Manifest hash, every exact payload hash, scope, regular-file containment and no-follow checks are verified before reporting pass. Inspect is integrity evidence only; it does not independently restore or validate Fusion BRep geometry.

examples.label: Inspect Captured Reference
examples.requires: Use the unmodified reference returned by measure.baseline.capture from the same canonical project.
examples.output: result.manifest lists pinned source/body/instance/pose metadata and result.bodyPayloads reports verified byte counts.

verified: typed CLI/MCP dispatch, manifest/payload checksums and owned-scope validation offline
bugs: Integrity inspection does not prove exact native import.

sections.title: Inputs And Identity
sections.text: baseline is the unchanged durable reference. bodies is a nonempty role/body array matching capture. Supply --doc-id or --doc-file-id for the current saved DataFile; a different fileId/version reports stale. tolerances must contain exactly nonnegative explicit volume, length and angle expressions. workBudgetMs is 1..300000 (default 30000); active synchronous SDK calls cannot be cancelled.

sections.title: Geometry And Pose Evidence
sections.text: Each current body is matched by role, stable body token and native/root-occurrence identity. Both A−B and B−A exact temporary solid Boolean differences are measured; translation and rotation are compared separately. Equal scalar volume, bbox and mesh samples are not equivalence. Missing/stale, kernel unknown and negative geometry/pose evidence never pass. Tolerance-qualified kernel equality is not a theorem about topology or physical fitness.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result={status:'pass'|'fail'|'missing'|'stale'|'unknown'|'unsupported',passed:boolean,precision:'exact',geometryEqual:boolean,poseEqual:boolean,bodies:[{role,aMinusB,bMinusA,emptyDifference,translationDelta,rotationDelta,volumeEqual,poseEqual}],tolerances,limitations}. Baseline payloads are imported to temporary geometry only; no document entities are inserted or saved. Native serializer/roundtrip remains unqualified until explicit scratch acceptance.

examples.label: Compare Housing And Shaft
examples.requires: Capture roles in the same source DataFile and supply its current document pin. This example is not native-validated.
examples.output: result.bodies contains both Boolean directions per role and separate placement deltas; any unproved/unknown row prevents passed:true.

sections.title: Nested Measurement Schema
sections.text: measurement required object with exactly operation:string and data:object. operation allowed: measure.diameter/radius/distance/angle/length/area/volume/mass/thickness. data must satisfy that operation's full input contract: ref plus optional units for diameter/radius/length/area/volume/mass; a,b,c? and units for angle; a,b,mode?,direction?,space?,units? for distance (minimum forbids direction/space; projected/axial require both and point refs or expression arrays); a,b,mode?:parallelPlanes,tolerance?,angleTolerance?,units? for thickness. Refs are discovered exact names/aliases or token/kind/component/occurrence/path objects, profiles additionally sketch/index or loopCount exclusive. Bounds/section/assembly checks and prior measurement result objects are not scalar specifications. Measurement executes now, before acceptance expressions are evaluated.

sections.title: Acceptance And Safety
sections.text: Require min and/or max OR expected (with optional tolerance default zero); expected is exclusive with either min/max, and tolerance forbidden without expected. All bounds/tolerance are explicit compatible dimensional expression strings (e.g. '1 mm^3', not raw numbers); tolerance nonnegative and min<=max. Bounds inclusive; omitted min/max becomes unbounded null. id and source optional arbitrary JSON values passed through (commonly strings), not independently verified. No activation/recompute/mutation; live reference/geometry and units compatibility still required. Returned values are snapshots; passing checks do not establish overall design acceptance.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result={id:JSON|null,source:JSON|null,actual:ScalarResult,acceptance:{min:number|null,max:number|null,units:string},passed:boolean,status:'pass'|'fail'}. ScalarResult always value:number,units:string,dimension:'length'|'angle'|'area'|'volume'|'mass',context:{space,component:Ref}. diameter/radius/length/area/volume/mass add ref:Ref,method:string (mass adds limitations); angle adds method; thickness adds method and limitations; minimum distance adds mode and points:number[2][3], projected/axial adds mode and direction:number[3]. Acceptance is converted into actual.units; expected +/- tolerance is returned as min/max, not original expressions. Executor created:[] and success:false when passed:false. Invalid geometry/expression throws rather than returning a failed tolerance row. In a batch after unique find face, measurement.data.ref may be {"$ref":"face.result"}; read checkStep.result.actual.value and checkStep.result.passed, not checkStep.result.value.

examples.label: Volume Target With Tolerance
examples.requires: BodyA uniquely discovered; target/tolerance are independently approved, not derived from the measurement being tested.
examples.output: result.acceptance is {min:999,max:1001,units:'mm3'}; result.passed depends on observed volume.

examples.label: One-Sided Projection Bound
examples.requires: Open Design document; explicit point coordinates and lower bound intentionally chosen.
examples.output: result.actual.value=10; acceptance.max=null and passed=true.

sections.title: Inputs And Preflight
sections.text: Two mutually exclusive forms are supported. Legacy: {parameter,expressions,confirm,checks?}. v2: {cases:[{id,assign:[{parameter,expression}],checks?}],confirm,timeBudgetMs?}. confirm:true is required. v2 accepts 1..1000 cases and at most 10000 assignments; IDs are unique, each case cannot assign one parameter twice, and every parameter/expression/check is resolved and validated before the first setter. Checks use existing scalar measurement inputs and dimensional limits. Text parameters, JSON numeric dimensions and asynchronous callbacks are unsupported. timeBudgetMs defaults to 180000 ms.

sections.title: Local Mutation And Restoration
sections.text: Each v2 case starts from the captured parameter baseline. Its finally attempts every original expression, computeAll, expression readback, health comparison and optional restoration callback; a restore failure stops later cases. The scheduling reserve is 1000 ms per case plus 250 ms per assignment, included inside timeBudgetMs; restorationReserveMsUsed and actualElapsedMs report actual work. budgetExceeded records an actual deadline overrun; budgetExhausted/continuation.reason records skipped forward work and may differ. Required skipped cases never pass. FMCAD.parameter_test(spec,check_case,check_restored) is trusted synchronous local Python; callbacks may read local geometry and create temporary B-Rep oracles, not save/upload/publish. Transport timeout while native finally is still running is unknown: reconcile before any new call. No automatic rollback/save; inspect primaryError and every restoreErrors entry.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: v2 returns {version:2,passed,status,cases,primaryError,restoreErrors,restored,timeBudgetMs,restorationReserveMsPlanned,restorationReserveMsUsed,actualElapsedMs,budgetExceeded,budgetExhausted,coverage,continuation?,limitations}. Each case reports id,status,passed,checks,health,primaryError,restoreErrors,restored and optional callback evidence. Legacy return remains {passed,status,samples,error,originalExpression,restored,restoreErrors,baselineHealth,restoredHealth,limitations}. Restored means expression/recompute/readback/health and requested restoration callback found no errors; it is not rollback. FMCAD.temporary_body(ref,frame) creates a temporary comparison source; FMCAD.compare_bodies(a,b,frame,volumeTolerance,linearTolerance,angularTolerance) compares both Boolean differences in that declared frame and separately checks pose. Boolean failures are errors, not empty differences. For results inspect each required case and restoration record; overall passed is false when required work was skipped.

examples.label: Confirmed Numeric Perturbation
examples.requires: width discovered as an existing numeric parameter in mm, user approved live perturbation and restoration; suitable editable parameter/design state.
examples.output: result.samples has completed sample rows; originalExpression,restored,error,restoreErrors must all be inspected.

examples.label: Perturb With A Volume Requirement
examples.requires: width and BodyA discovered, minimum volume independently approved; width may drive BodyA but the command does not establish that dependency for you.
examples.output: result.samples[0].checks[0].actual.value is volume in mm3 when sample completes; result.passed also requires healthy samples and successful restoration.

verified: nested check schema and deferred validation

sections.title: Inputs And Context
sections.text: a,b required distinct explicit solid BRepBody refs, not components/occurrences as geometry. Ref is exact unique body name or discovered {token,kind:'body',component?,occurrence?,path?}; use entity.list kind:body and kind:occurrence, qualifying both body refs with root-context full occurrence paths for placement. Same native component frame or explicit assembly proxies/root geometry required; mixed native components or nested native occurrence contexts rejected. volumeTolerance optional nonnegative dimensional volume expression default '0 mm^3'. No units field and minimum is forbidden. No activation, recompute, live Boolean/transform or save: native bodies copied and proxies transformed into temporary assembly geometry.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result={interferes:boolean,overlapVolume:Quantity,distance:Quantity,minimum:Quantity,volumeTolerance:Quantity,clearancePassed:boolean,method:string,context:{space:string,component:Ref},refs:Ref[2],passed:boolean}. Quantity={value:number,units:'mm3'|'mm',dimension:'volume'|'length'}; overlapVolume/volumeTolerance use mm3, distance/minimum mm. minimum is zero for interference. Interferes iff overlapVolume > volumeTolerance; passed=!interferes. clearancePassed additionally checks unsigned distance>=minimum. Positive overlap sets distance zero even below allowed volumeTolerance; contact is zero distance, not positive-volume overlap. Boolean kernel failure throws, never a no-interference result. Executor created:[] and success:false for failed check. Refs identify input bodies, while overlap geometry is never returned or added. This snapshot does not classify intentional fits. A prior unique body inspection A feeds a as A.result, not A.result.ref.

examples.label: Two Solid Bodies
examples.requires: Two distinct solid bodies uniquely discovered in one compatible context. For placed instances use occurrence-qualified discovered refs instead of native names.
examples.output: result.overlapVolume.value is mm3 and result.passed is the inverse of interferes; no overlap body token.

sections.title: Inputs And Prerequisites
sections.text: a,b required distinct explicit solid body refs discovered with entity.list kind:body or selection.inspect. Exact unique names/aliases or {token,kind:'body',component?,occurrence?,path?}; use full root-context occurrence paths from entity.list kind:occurrence for placed assembly bodies. Bodies need compatible native-component or root/proxy assembly frame. minimum optional nonnegative length expression default '0 mm'; volumeTolerance optional nonnegative volume expression default '0 mm^3'; both require units or dimensional parameters. No units/mode field. Open Design document required. Temporary native copies and proxy transforms only, no live geometry changes, activation, recompute or save.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result={interferes:boolean,overlapVolume:{value:number,units:'mm3',dimension:'volume'},distance:{value:number,units:'mm',dimension:'length'},minimum:{value:number,units:'mm',dimension:'length'},volumeTolerance:{value:number,units:'mm3',dimension:'volume'},clearancePassed:boolean,method:string,context:{space:string,component:Ref},refs:Ref[2],passed:boolean}. passed equals clearancePassed, requiring overlap<=volumeTolerance and distance>=minimum inclusively. Positive overlap forces distance zero, otherwise MeasureManager minimum distance; not penetration depth or axial gap. Contact can pass only for zero minimum and allowed overlap. Boolean failure raises instead of pass. Executor created:[] and success:false when passed:false. refs retain input body reference qualifications; numeric evidence is a snapshot. After pair step gap inspect gap.result.distance.value and gap.result.passed, not gap.result.value.

examples.label: Required Half-Millimeter Gap
examples.requires: Two distinct discovered solid bodies in compatible context; use occurrence-qualified refs if checking assembly instances. Minimum independently approved.
examples.output: result.distance uses mm and result.passed combines both volume and separation checks.

sections.title: Nested Input Schema
sections.text: moving required explicit solid body Ref; obstacles required nonempty array of other solid body Refs; moving cannot occur among obstacles, but duplicate obstacles are not deduplicated. translations required nonempty array of three-length-expression arrays, e.g. [['0 mm','0 mm','10 mm']]. Signed offsets are independent from original pose, not increments. mode only sampledTranslation default; minimum optional nonnegative length expression default '0 mm',volumeTolerance optional nonnegative volume expression default '0 mm^3'. No units/space/rotation/joint fields. Refs are exact unique names or discovered token/kind/component/occurrence/path; list bodies and root-context occurrence paths before checking placement. All refs must share compatible native-component or root/proxy assembly frame. Offsets use that reported frame, not a moving body's local axes when proxied.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result={context:{space:string,component:Ref},samples:[{index:zero-based integer,translation:{xyz:number[3],units:'mm'},checks:PairResult[],passed:boolean}],sampledPassed:boolean,obstacles:Ref[],continuousMotionVerified:false,limitations:string[]}. PairResult={interferes:boolean,overlapVolume:{value,units:'mm3',dimension:'volume'},distance:{value,units:'mm',dimension:'length'},minimum:{value,units:'mm',dimension:'length'},volumeTolerance:{value,units:'mm3',dimension:'volume'},clearancePassed:boolean,method:string}; checks are obstacle order and do NOT have refs,context or passed. Each sample.passed=all clearancePassed; sampledPassed=all samples passed. No top-level passed, moving ref, mode or status. Executor created:[] and success:false when sampledPassed:false, preserving the complete result. Failed batches skip later steps and refuse automatic replay/retry. continuousMotionVerified:false does not itself fail execution; sampled success is not continuous-motion verification. Example path motion.result.samples.1.checks.0.distance.value is mm, not a continuous travel distance.

sections.title: Safety And Limits
sections.text: Requires open Design document; all calculations use temporary body copies, translation transforms and Boolean intersection/minimum distance. No activation/recompute/live transforms/save. Kernel failure raises and no partial sample result is returned. Positive overlap means zero unsigned distance; volume tolerance and minimum are inclusive acceptance thresholds. Rotations, joint solver, contact dynamics, continuous sweep and collision proof between samples unsupported. These are evaluated snapshots, not an animation or kinematic simulation.

examples.label: Three Independent Translation Samples
examples.requires: BodyA/BodyB are discovered distinct solids in compatible context; offsets and gap approved. This samples only those poses.
examples.output: result.samples has three rows; each checks[0] corresponds to BodyB. Inspect result.sampledPassed, not executor success alone.

verified: explicit sampledPassed failure normalization (offline envelope and batch tests)

sections.title: Scope And Evidence
sections.text: Input exactly {}. Same handler/payload as snapshot. Requires open Design document; reads entire design, ignoring selected-component restriction. No activation/recompute/writes/files/save. Cached timeline/body values can be stale. Counts are definitions versus placed occurrences, not BOM quantities or acceptance. Body envelope uses ordinary boundingBox, NOT measure.bounds preciseBoundingBox; excludes sketch/construction/graphics from body rows but counts all definition sketches/features. Volume reads b.volume, not requested high-accuracy physical properties. Evidence is numeric observation, not driving geometry or rollback checkpoint.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result={schema:'fmcad.measure.snapshot.v1',document:{name:string,isModified:boolean},components:ComponentRow[],occurrences:OccurrenceRow[],parameters:ParameterInfo[],timeline:Health[],counts:Counts,issues:Health[],limitations:string[]}. ComponentRow={ref:Ref,bodies:[{ref:Ref,isSolid:boolean,faces:integer,edges:integer,volume:{value:number,units:'mm3',dimension:'volume'},bounds:{min:number[3],max:number[3],units:'mm',space:'component local'}}],sketchCount:integer,featureCount:integer}. OccurrenceRow={ref:Ref,component:Ref,transform:number[16],translationUnits:'cm'} in root occurrence order. ParameterInfo={name,expression,unit,comment:string,value:number|string,valueType:'numeric'|'text',valueUnits:internal-unit label|null,metadata:object}. Health={index:integer,name:string,state:string,message:string,suppressed:boolean,rolledBack:boolean}; state names Healthy/Warning/Error/SuppressedFeatureHealthState or unknown. Counts has integer componentDefinitions,occurrences,bodyDefinitions,sketchDefinitions,featureDefinitions,parameters,timelineItems. issues includes every nonhealthy state (including suppressed) or rolledBack. Ref uses token/kind/name, optional component/occurrence/path; root kind/name only. Executor created:[].

sections.title: Reference Wiring
sections.text: Pass audit.result (the full schema-tagged payload), not executor envelope, into diff.before. Body discovery reference is audit.result.components.N.bodies.M.ref, deliberately selected by identity; occurrence path is occurrences.N.ref.path. Parameter rows have names but no token/ref; use {kind:'parameter',name:row.name}. Batch step baseline can feed diff.before as {"$ref":"baseline.result"}. No snapshot files are created or loaded by these operations.

examples.label: Observe Full Design
examples.requires: Open Design document; reads cached state without guaranteeing it was recently recomputed.
examples.output: result.schema identifies snapshot format; result.counts distinguishes definitions/instances and result.issues lists cached timeline issues.

sections.title: Prerequisites And Limits
sections.text: Input exactly {}; requires open Design document. Full-design observation irrespective of selected component, no activation/recompute/mutation/files/save. Not a saved model, rollback checkpoint, full topology or acceptance certification. Cached state may be stale. Body volume from b.volume and ordinary boundingBox (not preciseBoundingBox or a new high-accuracy property request); parameter values are snapshots while expressions identify current relationships. Definitions are distinct from placed instances; hidden bodies remain included.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result={schema:'fmcad.measure.snapshot.v1',document:{name:string,isModified:boolean},components:[{ref:Ref,bodies:[{ref:Ref,isSolid:boolean,faces:integer,edges:integer,volume:{value:number,units:'mm3',dimension:'volume'},bounds:{min:number[3],max:number[3],units:'mm',space:'component local'}}],sketchCount:integer,featureCount:integer}],occurrences:[{ref:Ref,component:Ref,transform:number[16],translationUnits:'cm'}],parameters:[{name:string,expression:string,unit:string,value:number|string,valueType:'numeric'|'text',valueUnits:internal-unit label|null,comment:string,metadata:object}],timeline:Health[],counts:{componentDefinitions,occurrences,bodyDefinitions,sketchDefinitions,featureDefinitions,parameters,timelineItems:integers},issues:Health[],limitations:string[]}. Health={index:integer,name:string,state:string,message:string,suppressed:boolean,rolledBack:boolean}; state Healthy/Warning/Error/SuppressedFeatureHealthState or unknown, issues selects nonhealthy or rolledBack, including suppressed. Ref includes token:string|null,kind,name and optional component/occurrence refs,path for occurrences, root kind/name only. Occurrence matrix is asArray with cm translations; body bounds local mm. metadata may contain protected/source/tolerance, text values have null valueUnits. Executor created:[].

sections.title: Snapshot-To-Diff Wiring
sections.text: Retain the full result, not success/operation/document/result/created envelope, as diff.before; a second snapshot result is diff.after, or omit after to observe current state. In batch baseline then diff: before:{"$ref":"baseline.result"}. For subsequent measurement select components.N.bodies.M.ref from the snapshot based on actual identity. Do not use numeric bounds/volume as geometry refs or driving dimensions. Neither operation reads filenames.

examples.label: Capture In-Memory Evidence
examples.requires: Open Design document; use its returned result as data for later diff, not a filename.
examples.output: result contains schema,document,components,occurrences,parameters,timeline,counts,issues,limitations. No saved file path.

sections.title: Input Data And Comparison
sections.text: before required object with schema:'fmcad.measure.snapshot.v1'; after optional same object, omitted or null means current _measure_snapshot. Only schema tag/object type are validated, so minimal tagged objects are accepted; normally use complete earlier snapshot/audit.result rather than their executor envelope. No file path input. Full snapshots contain document,components,occurrences,parameters,timeline,counts,issues,limitations; comparison is generic recursive JSON, not entity identity matching. Dictionaries compare sorted key union, escape ~ as ~0 and / as ~1 in paths; token keys ignored at every dictionary level. Equal-length arrays compare positions; different-length arrays become one changed row for the whole array. Type changes (including integer versus float in Python) count; no numeric tolerance or topology equivalence.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result={changed:boolean,changes:[{path:string,change:'added'|'removed'|'changed',before:JSON|null,after:JSON|null}],limitations:string[]}. Missing dictionary value is represented null on the absent side; changed arrays may contain complete arrays. Paths are JSON-pointer-style rooted at '' (e.g. /parameters/0/expression), not batch dot paths. Executor created:[]. No mutation/activation/recompute/save. Even two supplied snapshots use normal executor open-Design context, although handler only reads current design if after null/omitted. Values retain their original field units. A batch baseline snapshot feeds before via {"$ref":"baseline.result"}; another snapshot current feeds after via current.result. result.changed means structural difference, not failure.

examples.label: Compare Supplied Schema-Tagged Data
examples.requires: No entity IDs. These deliberately minimal synthetic objects demonstrate structural comparison only; normally use complete observed snapshot results. Executor still requires an open Design document.
examples.output: result.changed=true; changes[0] is /document/name, change:changed, before:Example, after:Renamed.

sections.title: Prerequisites And Meaning
sections.text: Input exactly {}. Open Design document required; reads full snapshot internally, irrespective of selected component. No activation/recompute/writes/save. Consequently even though only status is returned, inaccessible body envelopes/parameter properties can fail snapshot collection. Cached timeline health is not an independent design acceptance test. Suppressed items count as issues here; this differs from parameter.test sampled health, which allows suppressed state but does not exercise it.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result={document:{name:string,isModified:boolean},counts:{componentDefinitions,occurrences,bodyDefinitions,sketchDefinitions,featureDefinitions,parameters,timelineItems:integers},issues:[{index:integer,name:string,state:string,message:string,suppressed:boolean,rolledBack:boolean}],observedHealth:'issues'|'noReportedIssues',acceptance:'notEvaluated',limitations:string[]}. state names Healthy/Warning/Error/SuppressedFeatureHealthState or unknown; issue rows are nonhealthy or rolledBack. No passed,schema,components,parameters array or tokens in this result; counts are definition/instance counts, not BOM quantities. Executor created:[]. No issues still leaves acceptance:notEvaluated; the command does not set independent approval metadata. Batch statusStep.result.document.isModified is an observation, not permission to discard work.

examples.label: Read Observed Status
examples.requires: Open Design document; no prior entity or parameter discovery required.
examples.output: result.acceptance is always notEvaluated, even when observedHealth is noReportedIssues.

sections.title: Nested Inputs
sections.text: checks optional array default []; metadata optional JSON object default {}, not null/scalar/array. Each check exactly accepts measurement:{operation:string,data:object},min?,max?,expected?,tolerance?,id?,source?. operation whitelist measure.diameter/radius/distance/angle/length/area/volume/mass/thickness; data is that scalar operation's input, not prior returned measurement. Single-ref operations use ref and optional units; angle a,b,c?,units; distance a,b,mode?,units? plus direction and space required only projected/axial (minimum forbids them); thickness a,b,mode?:parallelPlanes,tolerance?,angleTolerance?,units?. Refs are exact discovered names/aliases or token/kind/component/occurrence/path objects; profiles may use sketch/index or loopCount exclusive. Each check requires min and/or max OR expected with optional tolerance default zero. Bounds explicit compatible dimensional strings, tolerance>=0,min<=max; comparisons inclusive. id/source pass through unverified. Metadata can contain arbitrary nested JSON but cannot set acceptance.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result={status:Status,checks:CheckResult[],checkOutcome:'pass'|'fail'|'notEvaluated',userMetadata:object,metadataVerified:false,limitations:string[]}. Status={document:{name:string,isModified:boolean},counts:{componentDefinitions,occurrences,bodyDefinitions,sketchDefinitions,featureDefinitions,parameters,timelineItems:integers},issues:[{index:integer,name:string,state:string,message:string,suppressed:boolean,rolledBack:boolean}],observedHealth:'issues'|'noReportedIssues',acceptance:'notEvaluated',limitations:string[]}. CheckResult={id:JSON|null,source:JSON|null,actual:ScalarResult,acceptance:{min:number|null,max:number|null,units:string},passed:boolean,status:'pass'|'fail'}. ScalarResult has value:number,units,dimension,context:{space,component:Ref}; operation-specific ref/method/limitations or distance mode plus points (minimum) or direction (projected/axial). No checks means checkOutcome:notEvaluated, otherwise all passed gives pass. Executor created:[] and success:false when checkOutcome:'fail', preserving the complete result. Failed batches skip later steps and refuse automatic replay/retry. No checks can execute successfully while acceptance remains notEvaluated. metadataVerified:false and arbitrary nested metadata status/booleans do not fail execution. Read report.result.checks.N.actual.value and checkOutcome for supplied-check evidence.

sections.title: Execution And Safety
sections.text: Open Design document required. Checks execute first, then full-design status/snapshot reads; invalid check or status collection failure raises and no partial report is returned. No activation/recompute/mutation/files/save. Cached healthy timeline and unverified metadata do not establish design acceptance. For batch unique-find step face, use checks[0].measurement.data.ref:{"$ref":"face.result"}; report is evidence, not geometry or driving constraints. All live geometry feasibility/material correctness remains caller validation.

examples.label: Observed Status Without Checks
examples.requires: Open Design document, no entity IDs needed.
examples.output: result.checkOutcome=notEvaluated and result.metadataVerified=false.

examples.label: Volume Check With User Source
examples.requires: BodyA discovered uniquely and minimum independently approved; metadata is descriptive only.
examples.output: result.checks[0].passed and result.checkOutcome express check outcome; status.acceptance remains notEvaluated.

verified: nested check schemas and metadata object gate
explicit checkOutcome failure normalization (offline envelope and batch tests)

sections.title: Finite Inputs And Frames
sections.text: before and after are explicit solid body refs. frame is mandatory {space:'assembly'|'component local',component:Ref}; list bodies and occurrences first, use an occurrence-qualified proxy for each exact placed instance, and never mix coordinate frames. The source body units are already resolved by Fusion UnitsManager; output is internal cm/cm³. There is no scalar units override, point/ray/sample mode or primitive-mask syntax.

sections.title: Mask Set Semantics And Controls
sections.text: allowed/protected are optional {include:[body refs],exclude?:[body refs]} finite solid masks, each interpreted as Union(include)−Union(exclude). Overlaps count once; exclusion bodies are real holes; missing sectors and gaps stay uncovered. `geometry.delta` defaults both masks to empty, so any change fails its unchanged-region controls while both directed differences remain reported. Protected overlap is independently checked and always fails.

sections.title: Finite Evidence And Safety
sections.text: Computes removed=before−after and added=after−before separately, plus each total, inside/outside allowed, and inside protected finite solid. Equal-and-opposite volume never cancels. Exact status applies to positive-volume finite BRep coverage only; face/edge-only topology edits and topology identity are not proved. Boolean calls use private copies of both operands and do not add or transform source document bodies. Kernel exception/false/invalid BRep, stale/incomplete source, inconsistent partition or exhausted operation/time budget is unknown (passed:null), never exact pass. Time deadlines cannot cancel an indivisible SDK call.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result={schemaVersion:1,operation:'geometry.delta',status:'pass'|'fail'|'unknown',passed:boolean|null,precision,coverage,frame,units:{length:'cm',volume:'cm^3'},delta:{removed,added}|null,controls,comparison,provenance,budget,mutation,limitations}. Each directed delta holds total/insideAllowed/outsideAllowed/insideProtected={empty,volume,bounds}; bounds only locate the set and are not a coverage proof. A completed geometry.delta with any change is fail by default empty allowed/protected controls, but keeps both exact finite directed deltas.

examples.label: Allowed Region And Actual Hole
examples.requires: Discover the two solid states and each mask solid in the same declared frame; qualify assembly instances by full root occurrence path.
examples.output: result.delta.added and removed remain separate; each includes finite volume and bounds. Any added/removed volume in the mask hole appears in outsideAllowed and fails.

sections.title: Finite Inputs And Frames
sections.text: before, after and allowed are required explicit solid body refs. frame is mandatory {space:'assembly'|'component local',component:Ref}; all references must resolve in this frame. For placed instances use discovered root-context occurrence-qualified body proxies, not child-component native refs. Inputs are native finite solids, not sampled locations or analytic mask descriptors. Source geometry has already been resolved with Fusion UnitsManager; output units are cm and cm³.

sections.title: Allowed And Protected Masks
sections.text: Each mask is {include:[body refs],exclude?:[body refs]} and means Union(include)−Union(exclude). Intersecting include solids count once; exclusion solids remain holes; missing sectors/gaps remain outside. The optional protected mask is evaluated independently and wins in any overlap with allowed. An empty allowed include permits no change.

sections.title: Decision And Safety
sections.text: Both finite directed sets (before−after and after−before) are retained, then intersected/subtracted against the masks. Pass requires zero finite volume outside allowed and inside protected for both directions; no tolerance hides a positive region and added/removed volumes never cancel. Native BRep copy and Boolean calls never insert, edit or move document bodies. A zero-volume topological change is outside this finite-solid proof. Kernel failure, invalid input/result, stale refs/document/occurrence, inconsistent partition or exhausted budget is unknown, not a pass. Deadlines are checked between indivisible Fusion turns only.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result={schemaVersion:1,operation:'geometry.compare-region',status:'pass'|'fail'|'unknown',passed:boolean|null,precision,coverage,delta:{removed,added}|null,controls,comparison,frame,units,provenance,budget,mutation,limitations}. Every direction contains total,insideAllowed,outsideAllowed,insideProtected finite-solid rows with empty/volume/bounds. Bounds are a localization envelope only. Unknown returns no partial deltas and passed:null.

examples.label: Compare Against Allowed And Protected Solids
examples.requires: Discover exact source and finite mask BReps in one frame. Confirm occurrence-qualified refs and expected region exclusions before execution.
examples.output: status is pass only if both added and removed finite differences stay inside allowed and avoid protected. Protected wins over overlapping allowed.
